name: Nganurganity
description: A star 344 parsecs away, 257 times the Sun's width, measured from its light.

radius.source: McDonald, Zijlstra & Watson (2017), MNRAS 471, 770, table 2, HIP 33856: radius 256.839 solar radii, implied by the fitted luminosity 12254.2 solar luminosities (fractional uncertainty 0.093) and temperature

temperature.source: McDonald, Zijlstra & Watson (2017), MNRAS 471, 770, table 2, HIP 33856: effective temperature 3792 +/- 125 K, from the fit of a model atmosphere to the star's spectral energy distribution (goodness of fit Q 0.06)

gravity.source: SIMBAD's compilation of spectroscopic measurements (mesFe_h): log g 1.05 from 2007A&A...475.1003H; the 3 published values span log g 1 to 1.05, across which the limb law changes by at most 0.0% of the centre brightness

distance.source: McDonald, Zijlstra & Watson (2017), MNRAS 471, 770, table 2, HIP 33856: distance 343.643 pc, the paper's parallax inverted (Gaia DR1's where it revised the star's, else the Hipparcos reduction of van Leeuwen 2007; section 2.3; fractional uncertainty 0.065), at which the luminosity and radius hold

text.card: A star 344 parsecs away, 257 times the Sun's width, measured from its light.
text.introduction: Its brightness, measured band by band, gives 12,254 times the Sun's luminosity at 3,792 K, so 256.839 solar radii.
text.locator: Table 2, HIP 33856: D, Teff, L, Rad, Q

quotes.title: Sigma Canis Majoris
quotes.card: Sigma Canis Majoris is a variable star in the southern constellation of Canis Major.
quotes.introduction: It has the proper name Nganurganity ; Sigma Canis Majoris is its Bayer designation.
